[[There Goes the Neighborhood (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:There Goes The Neighborhood.jpg|215px]] | map1text = From Kaineng Center }} Save the peasants from the revenge-seeking mercenaries. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Travel to [[Bukdek Byway]] to protect the citizens from the retreating gangs. * Defeat the mercenaries attacking civilians. * Do not allow more than three groups of [[Peasant]]s to die. * Listen to [[Eri, Heart of Fire]] and determine her fate. * See [[Guardsman Qao Lin]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *3,000 [[Experience]] *1,500 [[Gold]] * [[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *[[Imperial Commendation]] ==Walkthrough== Getting closer than [[spirit range|two aggro bubbles]] to the hostile foes and allies will cause them to engage in combat, this allows you to recharge your skills and energy before charging towards the next group of allies. Use skills such as [["Fall Back!"]] to close the distance quickly to rescue the canthan peasants. Only one peasant needs to survive from each group to count as "saving" the group for the purposes of the quest. Consider microing heroes or telling human healers to heal peasants under fire. *{{a}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Silent Peacekeeper]] *{{rt}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Peacekeeper Clairvoyant]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"While your valor has certainly earned you a moment's rest, I'm afraid the Am Fah and Jade Brotherhood disagree. It seems they aren't taking their failure particularly well and are leaving a wake of destruction behind them as they fall back to regroup. At first they were simply looting the city, unwilling to go home empty-handed, but things are starting to turn a lot uglier out there. They've begun terrorizing the residents for sport, and I fear many lives will be lost if we do not intervene immediately."'' :''"My forces are too few to handle this alone, and the Ministry of Purity is nowhere to be found. You'd almost think they wanted the palace to fall! Our fine citizens have already had to endure far too many hardships; we can't stand idly by as these thugs kidnap, rob, and murder them! Please, if you are able, I ask you to go out and teach these bullies to pick on someone their own size!"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = We'll see who's terrified when I'm done with them! | decline = Oh, come on, I just saved your entire empire from certain destruction.
